name: Content Pipeline
description: Research a topic, draft an article, review it, then publish — a linear 4-stage fan-through that shows dependsOn wiring.

steps.title: Research: {{topic}}
steps.description: Research the topic "{{topic}}". Produce 5-8 key findings with sources, the current state of the art, and 3 angles worth writing about. Output as markdown.

steps.title: Draft an article on {{topic}}
steps.description: Using the research provided, write a 600-900 word article on "{{topic}}". Clear structure, engaging intro, concrete takeaways. Output the full article as markdown.

steps.title: Review the {{topic}} draft
steps.description: Review the drafted article for accuracy, clarity, and tone. List concrete edits, then output the corrected final article.

steps.title: Prepare {{topic}} for publishing
steps.description: Take the reviewed final article and prepare it for publishing: write an SEO title, meta description, 5 tags, and a 2-sentence social blurb. Output everything as markdown.
